Mossy exposed granite/gneiss bedrock cutting directly beside the pavement on a short steep urban hill, with a rustic wooden-post W-beam guardrail.

Two-storey wooden apartment houses with horizontal board cladding, white corner boards, decorated gable and glazed stair bay — classic Turku/Port Arthur-type wooden townscape rather than a stone-block city centre.

Small contracting firms (Oy) with mobile numbers, municipal parking automats, bilingual Finnish/Swedish administration — a bilingual coastal municipality with a student-service economy (Unica) rather than a heavy-industry town.
